nodes.description: mapping(uint256=>address) _owners: NFT ownership registry, mutated in _mint and _transfer
mapping(address=>uint256) _balances: token balance per holder, mutated in _mint/_burn/_transfer
mapping(uint256=>address) _tokenApprovals: per-token approvals cleared on transfer/burn
mapping(address=>mapping(address=>bool)) _operatorApprovals: operator approvals set via setApprovalForAll
uint256 maximumTokens: hard cap of NFTs, used in order/giveaway limits and tokensRemaining
uint256 _reserveTokens: owner-reserved supply, decremented in giveawayEmeeji
uint256 tokenPrice: price per NFT used for payment validation in orderEmeejis
uint256 purchaseLimit: maximum mints per order transaction
uint256 numberMinted: running counter of minted tokens, basis for token IDs
mapping(address=>uint256) percPayout: payout percentage per payee used in approvePayouts
mapping(address=>uint256) payoutAmount: accrued withdrawable balance per address
address[] payees: list of payout recipients iterated in approvePayouts
bool reentrancyLock: guard toggled inside orderEmeejis to block reentrant minting
bool orderLock: master switch gating orderEmeejis sales
string _baseURI: prefix concatenated in tokenURI
address _owner: Ownable owner slot written by _setOwner
public payable mint entrypoint: validates funds/limits/locks, accrues payouts, mints via _safeMint and refunds change with a raw call
onlyOwner free mint that decrements _reserveTokens and mints to an arbitrary recipient
external view returning payoutAmount of _msgSender()
onlyOwner view returning payoutAmount of an arbitrary address
internal: accrues payoutAmount for every payee using percPayout and the purchase amount
external withdrawal: zeroes caller payout then performs a raw ETH transfer to msg.sender
onlyOwner: sets orderLock to true
onlyOwner: sets orderLock to false
onlyOwner setter for tokenPrice
onlyOwner setter for purchaseLimit
onlyOwner setter for _baseURI metadata prefix
onlyOwner setter for _reserveTokens
onlyOwner setter for maximumTokens
public view returning maximumTokens - numberMinted
public view returning orderLock
public view returning _reserveTokens
external burn restricted to the current token owner
internal _transfer: clears approval and rewrites _owners/_balances
internal _mint: increments balance, writes ownership, emits Transfer
internal _safeMint: mints then performs receiver callback check for contract recipients
internal _burn: clears approvals and decrements balances
private: performs low-level try/catch call to onERC721Received on contract recipients
external ERC721 receiver hook returning the selector, target of the callback
external safe transfer variants validating approval then calling _safeTransfer
external transferFrom validating _isApprovedOrOwner then calling _transfer
external per-token approval with owner/operator checks
external operator approval using msg.sender as owner key
internal virtual hook called before every mint/transfer/burn
receive() payable: forwards plain ETH into approvePayouts
fallback() payable: forwards unknown-calldata ETH into approvePayouts
external view building the metadata URI from _baseURI and token id
ERC165 interface advertisement
onlyOwner: sets owner to address(0)
onlyOwner: transfers ownership to a non-zero newOwner
private _setOwner: writes _owner and emits OwnershipTransferred
constructor: seeds metadata, pricing, caps and payee payout table
Context._msgSender: returns msg.sender, indirection used by owner checks
Address library sendValue: forwards balance with a full-gas raw call
Address library functionCallWithValue: validates contract target and performs value-bearing call
Address library functionDelegateCall: delegatecall into a target contract
Address library functionStaticCall: staticcall into a target contract
msg.sender: attacker controllable caller address used for minting, refunds and withdrawals
raw msg.sender.call{value: cashChange}("") refund executed at the end of orderEmeejis
raw msg.sender.call{value: payout}("") ETH transfer in withdraw
recipient.call{value: amount}("") in Address.sendValue, forwards all gas to an arbitrary recipient
target.call{value: value}(data) in Address.functionCallWithValue with attacker-influenced calldata
uint256 orderSize parameter of orderEmeejis
uint256 mintSeedValue local snapshot of numberMinted inside orderEmeejis
uint256 cashIn local holding msg.value inside orderEmeejis
uint256 cashChange local refund amount sent to msg.sender in orderEmeejis
address _to recipient parameter of giveawayEmeeji
uint256 numberToMint parameter of giveawayEmeeji
uint256 currentToken local used as the mint id base in giveawayEmeeji
uint256 payout local read from payoutAmount in withdraw
uint256 purchaseAmount parameter of approvePayouts
address newOwner parameter of transferOwnership
uint256 tokenId parameter of transferFrom
address to parameter of transferFrom
address from parameter of transferFrom
uint256 amount parameter of setTokenPrice
string uri_ parameter of setBaseURI
address payable recipient parameter of Address.sendValue
address target parameter of Address.functionCallWithValue
uint256 value parameter of Address.functionCallWithValue

edges.reason: orderEmeejis reads tokenPrice to compute the required payment
orderEmeejis subtracts _reserveTokens and numberMinted from maximumTokens in a require comparison
orderEmeejis uses _reserveTokens in the remaining-supply arithmetic
orderEmeejis reads and increments numberMinted to derive mint ids
orderEmeejis gates execution on orderLock
orderEmeejis sets and clears reentrancyLock around the external call
msg.sender supplies msg.value and is the mint recipient in orderEmeejis
the refund call target is the attacker-controlled msg.sender
withdraw reads payoutAmount and transfers ETH to msg.sender
withdraw has no access control and is callable by any msg.sender
checkMyWallet returns the payout of msg.sender
setApprovalForAll keys the operator approval map on msg.sender
transferOwnership onlyOwner gate compares owner() with _msgSender()
giveawayEmeeji onlyOwner gate checks the caller against _msgSender()
orderEmeejis performs the raw refund call after minting and state updates
orderEmeejis invokes approvePayouts with the full cash amount
orderEmeejis mints each token through _safeMint
giveawayEmeeji mints through _safeMint
approvePayouts accumulates payoutAmount with multiplication and division
approvePayouts multiplies purchaseAmount by percPayout shares
approvePayouts iterates the payees array
withdraw executes the raw ETH call to msg.sender
withdraw reads and zeroes payoutAmount for msg.sender
_safeMint calls _mint before the receiver check
_mint increments _balances[to]
_mint writes _owners[tokenId]
_mint invokes the _beforeTokenTransfer hook
_safeMint calls _checkOnERC721Received which performs an external call
_checkOnERC721Received calls the recipient's onERC721Received hook, allowing reentry
receive() forwards msg.value into approvePayouts
fallback() forwards msg.value into approvePayouts
transferFrom delegates to _transfer
safeTransferFrom routes into _safeTransfer/_transfer
_transfer rewrites _owners[tokenId]
_transfer decrements and increments _balances entries
_burn decrements _balances[owner]
_burn deletes _owners[tokenId]
burn requires _msgSender() to equal the token owner before calling _burn
transferOwnership onlyOwner then calls _setOwner
renounceOwnership onlyOwner then calls _setOwner
constructor sets the deployer as owner through _setOwner
_setOwner writes the privileged _owner slot
_msgSender returns the msg.sender untrusted input
Address.sendValue performs the raw value call to an arbitrary recipient
Address.functionCallWithValue performs the value-bearing call to an arbitrary target
cashChange local is the value supplied to the refund call in orderEmeejis
orderSize drives value, purchase-limit and remaining-supply arithmetic
purchaseAmount is the multiplicand for payee payout shares
payout local is forwarded as the value of the raw call in withdraw
newOwner parameter is validated and written to the owner slot
amount parameter written into tokenPrice by the privileged setter
uri_ parameter written into _baseURI by the privileged setter
recipient parameter is the destination of the raw call in sendValue
target parameter is the call target in functionCallWithValue
value parameter is the ETH amount forwarded in functionCallWithValue
checkMyWallet reads payoutAmount
checkWallet reads payoutAmount
tokenURI concatenates _baseURI with the token id
setTokenPrice writes tokenPrice under onlyOwner
setPurchaseLimit writes purchaseLimit under onlyOwner
setBaseURI writes _baseURI under onlyOwner
setReserveTokens writes _reserveTokens under onlyOwner
setTotalTokens writes maximumTokens under onlyOwner
tokensRemaining subtracts numberMinted from maximumTokens
tokensRemaining reads numberMinted
checkReserves reads _reserveTokens
checkOrderLock reads orderLock
lockOrders sets orderLock under onlyOwner
unlockOrders sets orderLock under onlyOwner
giveawayEmeeji increments numberMinted in a loop
giveawayEmeeji decrements _reserveTokens
_beforeTokenTransfer is an empty virtual hook

normalization_plan.reason: orderSize only exists as the mint quantity input of orderEmeejis and should be folded into that core function
mintSeedValue is a transient copy of numberMinted used only inside orderEmeejis
cashIn is a transient alias of msg.value scoped to orderEmeejis
cashChange is the exact value passed into the refund raw call and should be merged into that unsafe operation
_to is the recipient argument consumed only by giveawayEmeeji
numberToMint controls the giveawayEmeeji mint loop and belongs to that function
currentToken is a loop base local used only within giveawayEmeeji
payout is the exact value forwarded by the raw call in withdraw and should be merged into that unsafe operation
purchaseAmount is the sole input of approvePayouts
newOwner is the ownership argument validated inside transferOwnership
tokenId is consumed by transferFrom for approval and transfer checks
to is the destination argument of transferFrom
from is the source argument of transferFrom
amount is the only input of the setTokenPrice setter
uri_ is the only input of the setBaseURI setter
recipient is the raw call destination in Address.sendValue and should merge into that unsafe operation
target is the call destination in functionCallWithValue and should merge into that unsafe operation
value is the forwarded ETH amount in functionCallWithValue and should merge into that unsafe operation
